How to use KUMAR Masters

The catalogue and the network. Change things here and the rest of the system follows - warranty periods, model specs, who a dealer reports to.

Do this, in order

  1. Pump Category sets the default warranty months for a whole family.
  2. Pump Model holds the real specs from the brochure and can override the category's warranty. Each model points at one stock Item.
  3. Dealer Tree is a hierarchy: Branch - Distributor - Dealer - Sub-Dealer. A dealer login sees its own records and everything below it, nothing sideways.
  4. Settings holds every assumption - SLA hours, warranty basis, QC enforcement, QR base URL. Nothing is hardcoded.

Watch out for

  • Give a dealer a login by setting Portal User on the Dealer record. That single field is what row-level access is derived from.
